dossiers.label: Heraclitus' river
dossiers.about: In the etymologies Socrates finds Heraclitus behind the names of Cronus and Rhea: everything gives way and nothing stays; likening things to the flow of a river, he says you could not step twice into the same river.

passage.end_quote: δὶς ἐς τὸν αὐτὸν ποταμὸν οὐκ ἂν ἐμβαίης

parts.label: You could not step twice into the same river
parts.quote: δὶς ἐς τὸν αὐτὸν ποταμὸν οὐκ ἂν ἐμβαίης

echoes.why: At the end: can there be knowledge if all things flow?
The Theaetetus: Heraclitus and the poets behind the doctrine that all is motion.

web.title: Heraclitus
web.quote: You cannot step into the same river twice
